spec.goal: Execute XY-152 by replacing the frozen capture glow border with a conventional screenshot-selection treatment where the selected region stays bright and the non-selected area is dimmed.
success_criteria: A valid saved plan/1 artifact exists for XY-152 and is used as the execution authority for this lane.
Frozen mode no longer relies on the animated selection-flow ring as the primary affordance for a captured region.
When a frozen capture rect exists, the selected capture region remains clear while the non-selected area is visibly dimmed.
The frozen capture boundary remains easy to read through the bright-versus-dim transition alone, without adding a separate static border.
Window-freeze and dragged-region freeze both use the new treatment without regressing fullscreen fallback behavior.
Focused verification covers the new frozen selection geometry behavior and the touched overlay test surface stays green.
constraints: Keep the implementation scoped to frozen-mode overlay visuals and related tests unless execution proves a tighter dependency.
Do not widen live-mode hover or drag affordance behavior while replacing the frozen affordance.
Prefer a renderer-local implementation that avoids introducing new platform-specific masking pipelines unless the current renderer makes that necessary.
Use repo-native Rust verification for the touched overlay scope before claiming completion.

defaults.recommended_approach: draw four dimmed scrim rectangles around the frozen capture rect and rely on the bright-versus-dim contrast instead of an animated or static border

evidence: Task 1 outcome: packages/rsnap-overlay/src/overlay.rs now keeps the existing animated selection-flow ring for live mode and for the pre-image frozen pending path only, while frozen mode with a resolved frozen image switches to a conventional dimmed-outside scrim treatment.
Task 1 outcome: the frozen scrim path no longer depends on selection_particles being enabled, so the conventional frozen affordance still renders even when animated particles are disabled.

Task 2 outcome: frozen_selection_scrim_rects() computes four outside rectangles around the focus rect and render_frozen_selection_scrim() skips zero-area regions, which keeps edge-aligned selections and fullscreen fallback free of invalid outside geometry.

Task 2 outcome: the final frozen treatment does not add a separate static border; it relies on the bright selected region versus dimmed outside area, matching the user-requested traditional screenshot behavior.

Task 2 tune-up: post-implementation visual review increased the frozen outside scrim alpha again so the bright-versus-dim contrast is more obvious in real use without reintroducing any border treatment.
Task 3 outcome: added focused geometry tests covering framed selections, edge-flush zero-area outside regions, and fullscreen selections with no outside scrim area.
Task 3 verification: cargo test -p rsnap-overlay frozen_selection_scrim_rects --lib passed with 3 tests passing and 0 failures.
Task 3 verification: cargo test -p rsnap-overlay overlay:: --lib passed with 76 tests passing and 0 failures.
